hassio_account.title: Connect your YI Home account
hassio_account.description: Enter your YI Home account. The password is sent directly to the YI Home App and is not stored in the Home Assistant config entry.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the YI Home App.
error.rate_limited: YI temporarily rate-limited login attempts. Try again later.
error.account_setup_failed: The YI account could not be configured.

abort.app_required: Install and start the YI Home App first.
abort.invalid_discovery: The YI Home App published invalid discovery information.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the discovered YI Home App.
abort.unsafe_backend: The YI Home App returned an unsafe backend state.
abort.app_auth_failed: Home Assistant could not authenticate to the YI Home App.
